expected_findings.title: Server-side request forgery via user-controlled URL
expected_findings.remediation: Resolve the URL and check it against an allow-list of hosts and schemes.

expected_findings.title: XML external entity expansion enabled
expected_findings.remediation: Disable entity resolution and external DTD loading in the parser.

expected_findings.title: Archive extracted without validating member paths (zip slip)
expected_findings.remediation: Pass filter='data', or resolve each member and reject paths that escape.

expected_findings.title: Server-side template injection via user-controlled template
expected_findings.remediation: Render a fixed template and pass untrusted values in as context variables.

expected_findings.title: Open redirect to a user-controlled location
expected_findings.remediation: Allow only relative paths or destinations from a fixed allow-list.

expected_findings.title: LDAP injection via concatenated search filter
expected_findings.remediation: Escape filter metacharacters with a dedicated LDAP escaping routine.
